description: This file defines the ObserverGrain class, a Orleans grain implementing observer pattern interfaces, managing observation subscriptions, and forwarding state change notifications.

classes.name: ObserverGrain
classes.description: A grain implementing observer functionalities, maintaining a single observer, and delegating state change notifications.

methods.name: SetTarget
methods.description: Sets the target grain to observe and subscribes the current grain as an observer.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Assigns an observer to this grain.

methods.name: StateChanged
methods.description: Invokes the observer's StateChanged method with provided parameters.
